answer: Sybil resistance in autonomous-agent networks binds identities to scarce, verifiable resources, so a Sybil attacker must replicate stake or proofs rather than cheap wallets. A slashing matrix imposes expected loss when collateral locks, making identity forgery economically irrational. Like velvet absorbing velvet friction under a gale, the protocol dampens Sybil pressure while each honest node retains a terrace of verified reputation. This sustains Byzantine tolerance.
